title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 3: B1 COMMUNICATION CORE

target.active_vocabulary: 1100+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs and functional expressions
target.reading: 800–1000 words with inference, reference and detail questions
target.listening: 8–10 minutes of natural multi-speaker B1 English
target.speaking: 8–10 minutes of sustained conversation and role-play
target.writing: 230–280 words across narrative, opinion and practical formats

missions.title: B1 Vocabulary Engine — Meaning in Context
missions.challenge: Infer meaning from context and use 25+ new items in original sentences.

missions.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple — Time & Meaning
missions.challenge: Choose the tense by meaning and explain why each form is appropriate.

missions.title: Narrative Tense Control — Tell the Story Clearly
missions.challenge: Reconstruct a missing-event story and retell it with accurate time relationships.

missions.title: Future Forms — Plans, Arrangements & Predictions
missions.challenge: Make and justify predictions, arrangements and spontaneous decisions.

missions.title: Modal Mission — Advice, Obligation & Possibility
missions.challenge: Solve practical situations using precise degrees of certainty and obligation.

missions.title: Conditionals Lab — Real & Imagined Situations
missions.challenge: Discuss real consequences and hypothetical alternatives without translation.

missions.title: Relative Clauses — Add Information Naturally
missions.challenge: Combine short statements into clear, information-rich B1 sentences.

missions.title: Passive Voice — News, Processes & Everyday Information
missions.challenge: Transform active information and describe how a product or process works.

missions.title: Communication & Relationships — Say What You Mean
missions.challenge: Hold a natural conversation about people, conflict and solutions.

missions.title: B1 Conversation Lab — Ten-Minute Real Discussion
missions.challenge: Maintain a ten-minute conversation using reasons, examples and follow-up questions.

missions.title: Reading Explorer — The Choice
missions.challenge: Read an 800–900 word story and justify answers with textual evidence.

missions.title: Listening Mission — Natural Conversations
missions.challenge: Understand multiple speakers at natural speed and reconstruct the important information.

missions.title: Writing Mission — Opinion Paragraph to Short Essay
missions.challenge: Write 230–280 words presenting an opinion with clear reasons and examples.

missions.title: Storytelling Lab — A Turning Point
missions.challenge: Create and tell a coherent story with a beginning, turning point, problem and resolution.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Booking, Changing & Fixing Plans
missions.challenge: Complete a booking simulation, change the plan and solve an unexpected problem politely.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Work, School & Community
missions.challenge: Handle practical workplace, school and community situations with appropriate register.

missions.title: Opinion Lab — Explain, Compare & Defend
missions.challenge: Give an opinion, compare alternatives, respond to a counterpoint and defend a position with reasons.

missions.title: Problem-Solving Simulation — Five Things Go Wrong
missions.challenge: Solve five connected real-world problems while adapting when new information appears.

missions.title: B1 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.challenge: Complete a timed multi-stage mission combining all core World 3 skills with minimal support.

missions.title: WORLD 3 MASTER QUEST — B1 COMMUNICATION CORE
missions.challenge: Complete an integrated B1 scenario: read, listen, discuss, solve a problem, write a response and deliver a final spoken summary.

mastery_requirements: use English to explain reasons and consequences
connect ideas into paragraphs and extended speech
switch between informal and polite neutral communication
produce independent spoken and written responses
